title: Animator contract and interaction spec for dynamic insight panels
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Define a clear interaction contract and animator-spec for the new dynamic insight panels used across Cost Explorer, Rollouts, and Runtime dashboards. Deliverables: a) explicit state machine diagrams (collapsed/expanded/pinned/focused/dragging) expressed as textual contracts, b) a Figma interactive prototype with Animator tokens, c) a lightweight animator API proposal for Engineering (duration curves, sequencing, spring vs. ease, reduced-motion behavior), and d) acceptance criteria for QA and accessibility reviews. This ticket focuses on the design system artifact (component-level interaction contract + motion tokens) so Engineering can implement a consistent animator utility rather than many ad-hoc animations across the console.
acceptance_criteria: Single-page interaction contract (text + state table) published in Confluence link and referenced by component library
Figma prototype demonstrates collapse/expand, pin-to-top, drag-to-reorder, and focus-to-detail transitions with adjustable timing tokens
Animator token palette including durations, easing curves, and z-index choreography added to design tokens library
Reduced-motion variant specified and validated in prototype; meets WCAG motion considerations
Engineering sign-off on the animator API proposal with agreed minimal surface (start/stop/interrupt, stagger, interrupt behavior)
Perf constraints documented: max total animation GPU cost budget per route and guidelines for very low-end devices
comments: 2025-11-10 - Aisha Patel: Kickoff meeting notes attached. Agreed to split the work into: contract doc (this ticket), Figma prototype (DES-916668), eng API proposal (ENG-20412). Confluence draft: https://confluence.redwood/example/animator-contract
2025-11-12 - Marco Alvarez: Early prototype pasted in Figma. Using 160ms/240ms/360ms token set as a starting point. Link: https://www.figma.com/file/xxxxxxxx/animator-specs
2025-11-13 - UX Research (Rina Cho): Ran micro-interaction interview with two customers; preference for snappier collapse (<200ms) but slower detail reveal (~300-360ms). Added notes to the prototype.

2025-11-14 - Engineering (Jamal Nguyen): Raised concern about continuous layout thrashing during drag-to-reorder on low-end GPUs. Action: provide non-layout fallback (opacity + transform-only) and a perf test harness. Added as dependency ENG-20455.

2025-11-15 - Accessibility review (Marta Silva): Requested explicit reduced-motion mapping and a11y-friendly focus transition (avoid color-only motion). Also requested keyboard-only interaction flows be tested in prototype.

2025-11-16 - Aisha Patel: Updated contract doc to include interruption policy (last-wins vs queue) and explicit examples of concurrent transitions (collapse + pin). Added animation token names: anim.duration.short, anim.duration.medium, anim.duration.long, anim.curve.default, anim.curve.enter-heavy, anim.curve.exit-soft.
2025-11-17 - Marco Alvarez: Posted draft animator API in GitHub gist and linked implementation notes. Gist: https://gist.github.com/marco/animator-api-proposal. Requesting eng review in ENG-PR-20478.
notes: Trade-offs discussed: prefer transform/opacity over layout for better perf; maintain semantic DOM order to preserve screen-reader reading order; keep duration tokens limited (3 sizes) to avoid inconsistent timing across components. Next step: pair workshop with frontend eng to prototype an interruptible animator utility and run perf numbers on Chrome on a m5.large-equivalent remote VM.
